;Armed conflicts and attacks
*The [[United Nations]] reports the discovery of five "likely" mass graves in [[Blukwa Centre]] and [[Maze/Waliba]] in [[Ituri]], [[Democratic Republic of Congo]]. [https://www.news24.com/Africa/News/un-discovers-five-likely-mass-graves-in-drc-20180427 (News24)]
;Arts and culture
*[[Cinema of Saudi Arabia]]
**Three [[4DX]] locations are expected to open in [[Riyadh]] and other major [[Saudi Arabia]] cities. [http://www.arabianbusiness.com/media/395227-worlds-first-4d-cinema-firm-signs-deal-for-saudi-debut (''Arabian Business'')]
*[[Harvey Weinstein sexual abuse allegations]]
**American actor [[Brad Pitt]] announces that he will produce a film about the allegations of sexual misconduct against American film producer [[Harvey Weinstein]]. [https://www.firstpost.com/entertainment/brad-pitts-production-house-to-make-film-on-new-york-times-harvey-weinstein-expose-4446943.html (''Firstpost'')] [http://people.com/movies/brad-pitt-produce-movie-harvey-weinstein-rocky-history/ (''People'')]
;Business and economy
*[[Erin Energy]], a [[Texas]] company specialising in [[Africa]]n offshore oil deposits with licences to explore off [[Nigeria]], [[The Gambia]], [[Ghana]], and [[Kenya]], files for bankruptcy protection. [https://splash247.com/erin-energy-files-chapter-11-bankruptcy-protection/ (Splash 24/7)]
;Disasters and accidents
*An explosion occurs in the [[Husky Oil]] Refinery in [[Superior, Wisconsin]]. Five people are reportedly injured. Local residents have been ordered to evacuate. [http://mix108.com/explosion-reported-at-superiors-husky-refinery-injuries-reported/ (mix108)]
*Thirteen children are killed after their school bus collides with a train in the [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-43903275 (BBC)]
*[[Flash flood]]s strike a class hiking trip in the Nahal Tzafit riverbed in the [[Dead Sea]], [[Israel]]. Nine children are killed and another is reported missing. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/9-youths-missing-after-class-trip-swept-away-by-flash-flood-near-dead-sea/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*The [[Transportation Safety Board of Canada|Transportation Safety Board]] of [[Canada]] concludes [[spatial disorientation|pilot disorientation]] was the most likely cause of a plane crash that killed former [[Premier of Alberta]] [[Jim Prentice]] and three others. The TSB asks [[Transport Canada]] to mandate [[cockpit voice recorder]]s and [[flight data recorder]]s on all commercial and private business aircraft. [http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/calgary/tsb-report-jim-prentice-plane-crash-release-1.4635541 (CBC)]
*[[Disasters in Indonesia]]
**The death toll from yesterday's oil well explosion and fire in [[Pasir Putih]], [[Aceh]], [[Indonesia]], reaches 22. [http://www.startribune.com/death-toll-from-fire-at-indonesian-oil-well-rises-to-21/480910641/ (Star Tribune)]
;International relations
*[[United States and weapons of mass destruction]]
**The [[United States Air Force]] tests a [[LGM-30 Minuteman|Minuteman III]] [[intercontinental ballistic missile]] from [[Vandenberg Air Force Base]] in [[California]]. The missile test is considered to be successful. [https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/government-economy/us-air-force-tests-missile-in-california (''Business Times'')]
*[[Iran–Israel relations]]
**[[Israel]] foreign minister [[Avigdor Lieberman]] warns that the country will hit [[Tehran]] if [[Iran]] attacks [[Tel Aviv]]. [https://reuters.com/article/amp/idUSKBN1HX15P (Reuters)]
*[[South Korea–United States relations]]
**[[South Korea]] and the [[United States]] suspend their [[Foal Eagle]] military exercises. Furthermore, they also finish parts of the [[Key Resolve]] exercises. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2018/04/26/South-Korea-US-to-stop-military-drills-for-summit/5001524753504/ (UPI)]
*[[United Kingdom–United States relations]]
**U.S. President [[Donald Trump]] announces that he will [[List of international presidential trips made by Donald Trump|visit]] the [[United Kingdom]] on July 13. [https://news.sky.com/story/donald-trump-uk-visit-date-confirmed-for-13-july-11347502 (Sky News)]
;Law and crime
*[[Corruption in Spain]]
**Former [[President of the Community of Madrid]], ex-[[Mayor of Madrid]] and ex-[[Minister of Justice (Spain)|Minister of Justice]] [[Alberto Ruiz Gallardón]] is imputed by his role in Lezo Operation corruption scandal. [https://politica.elpais.com/politica/2018/04/26/actualidad/1524759005_587173.html (''El País'')]
*[[Bill Cosby sexual assault case]]
**[[Bill Cosby]] is found guilty of three counts in regard to an [[aggravated sexual assault]] of a woman in 2004 in a [[retrial]]. He faces a maximum sentence of ten years imprisonment and a fine of up to [[United States dollar|$]]25,000 on each count. [https://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/bill-cosby-scandal/bill-cosby-found-guilty-sexual-assault-retrial-n869121 (NBC News)]
*[[Palestinian political violence|Terrorism in Israel]]
**Ali Abu Hassan, a [[Hebron University]] student from [[State of Palestine|Palestine]], is convicted of planning a terror attack against [[light rail]] in [[Jerusalem]] using [[pipe bomb]]s containing nails coated in rat poison. He is found guilty of attempted murder, manufacturing weapons, and an immigration offence. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/palestinian-convicted-of-attempt-to-bomb-jerusalem-light-rail/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Far-right terrorism in the United Kingdom]]
**Five alleged members of [[United Kingdom|British]] [[Neo-Nazism|neo-Nazi]] group [[National Action (UK)|National Action]] go on trial in [[Birmingham]] charged with [[inciting racial hatred]] at [[Aston University]]. National Action is a banned terror group. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-birmingham-43909992 (BBC)] [http://www.sthelensstar.co.uk/news/16147313.Man_accused_of_being_member_of_banned_group_National_Action_in_court/ (''The St. Helens Star'')] <!--Second link is to explain the significance of National Action-->
*[[La Manada sexual abuse case]]
**A court in [[Pamplona]], Spain, convicts a group of five men on charges of [[sexual abuse]] at the festival of [[San Fermín]] in 2016, clearing them of charges of [[gang rape]]. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2018-04-27/five-men-cleared-of-gang-rape-in-spain/9702290 (ABC Online)]
**Thousands of people throughout Spain protest the court's verdict. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/apr/26/protests-spain-five-men-cleared-of-teenagers-gang-rape-pamplona (''The Guardian'')]
;Politics and elections
*[[Mueller special counsel investigation]]
**In the [[United States]], the [[Senate Judiciary Committee]] votes on a bill to protect Special Counsel [[Robert Mueller]]. The bill passes 14–7. [http://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/article209864164.html (''The Miami Herald'')]
*[[Political appointments of the first Trump administration|Political appointments by Donald Trump]]
**[[Ronny Jackson]] withdraws as nominee for [[United States Secretary of Veterans Affairs]]. [https://www.npr.org/2018/04/26/605471807/dr-ronny-jackson-withdraws-as-va-nominee (NPR)]
**The [[United States Senate]] votes 57–42 to confirm former [[Central Intelligence Agency|CIA]] Director [[Mike Pompeo]] as [[United States Secretary of State|Secretary of State]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-43910164 (BBC)]
*[[List of ambassadors appointed by Donald Trump (2017–2021)|United States Ambassadors appointed by Donald Trump]], [[Germany–United States relations]]
**[[Richard Grenell]] is confirmed as the U.S. ambassador to [[Germany]]. [https://www.thelocal.de/20180427/trump-ally-grenell-confirmed-as-us-ambassador-to-germany (''The Local'')]

**In [[American football]], the [[National Football League]] starts its [[2018 NFL draft|draft]] for the 2018 season, with the [[Cleveland Browns]] selecting [[Baker Mayfield]] with the [[List of first overall National Football League draft picks|first]] overall pick.
